name: Server Health Check
description: Check server health via SSH and create a report. Uses hosts from config/ssh.json.

params.command:
echo '=== UPTIME ===' && uptime && echo '
=== MEMORY ===' && free -h && echo '
=== DISK ===' && df -h / && echo '
=== LOAD ===' && cat /proc/loadavg && echo '
=== TOP PROCESSES ===' && ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -6

steps.llm_prompt:
Create a server health report from this SSH output.

Host: ${host}
Checked at: ${check_time} at ${check_hour}
Stash reference: ${stash_ref}

Raw Output:
${ssh_output}

Format as markdown with:
- Server Status (up/healthy or issues)
- Uptime
- Memory Usage (used/total, percentage)
- Disk Usage (used/total, percentage)
- Load Average (1/5/15 min)
- Top memory-consuming processes
- Any concerns or recommendations

success_speech: Health check complete for ${host}. Report saved to canvas.
abort_speech: Couldn't connect to ${host}. Check SSH configuration with 'list ssh hosts'.
